items.title: Generalize runtime join filtering to subqueries, joins and larger key sets

labels.name: priority: P2
labels.description: Next wave: broader query capability and remaining operational visibility.

items.body:
The current lookup optimization accepts one ordinary local table with an independent scan. Real applications often derive their filtering keys from joins, subqueries or another distributed input. These shapes can miss remote filtering even when the resulting key set is small.

Generalize runtime join filtering to consume a safely executable input plan, preserving its SQL semantics. Develop bounded transport for larger key sets instead of relying exclusively on one materialized array payload.

## Example partitioning and query

On the controller, partition events by tenant and distribute leaves across replicas. On the requesting reader, keep `tenants` and `memberships` locally.

```sql
CREATE TABLE events (
  tenant_id bigint, event_id bigint, occurred_at timestamptz, payload jsonb
) PARTITION BY HASH (tenant_id);
CREATE TABLE events_0 PARTITION OF events
  FOR VALUES WITH (MODULUS 2, REMAINDER 0);
CREATE TABLE events_1 PARTITION OF events
  FOR VALUES WITH (MODULUS 2, REMAINDER 1);
CREATE TABLE tenants (tenant_id bigint, enabled boolean);
CREATE TABLE memberships (tenant_id bigint, user_id bigint);

SELECT e.tenant_id, e.event_id
FROM events e
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM tenants t
  JOIN memberships m USING (tenant_id)
  WHERE t.enabled AND m.user_id = 42 AND t.tenant_id = e.tenant_id
);
```

Evaluate the local tenant/membership join once, route its qualifying keys to relevant shards, and filter remotely before transferring event rows. The EXISTS query returns each matching event occurrence once regardless of duplicate membership rows.

## Expected plan (schematic)

These are desired logical stages, not captured EXPLAIN output or a commitment to exact executor node names. Indented inputs supply rows to their parent; labels show where work executes.

Before: an unsupported multi-table lookup input can leave the reader joining a broad stream of foreign event rows. The target is to derive an independent key input once and use it to restrict remote work.

```text
Build filter once                                    [reader]
  Materialize qualifying tenant keys
    Join tenants with memberships
      Filter tenants.enabled
      Filter memberships.user_id = 42

Return matching event occurrences                    [reader]
  Routed remote SEMI/EXISTS execution
    Destination 0: scan events_0 WHERE EXISTS(keys_0)  [remote]
    Destination 1: scan events_1 WHERE EXISTS(keys_1)  [remote]
    Empty key subset: skip destination entirely
```

The materialized keys feed the requests above as runtime parameters; they are not embedded into a cached generic plan. Local leaves, when present, use the same key materialization for local membership checks.

- **Gain:** only matching event rows return, and destinations without possible matches receive no scan request.
- **Boundary:** exact SEMI batches must not duplicate an event that matches keys in multiple batches. INNER joins still preserve lookup multiplicity.
- If a Bloom filter is used instead, the row pipeline is `remote Bloom prefilter -> local exact SEMI/join check -> output`. The exact check removes false positives; the filter must never remove a real match.

## Scope and correctness

- Start with independent, nonvolatile local subquery/join plans; explicitly define handling of CTEs, rescans and prepared parameters. Correlated, security-sensitive or unshippable cases must retain the existing path unless separately proven safe.
- For larger key sets, assess bounded exact-key batches and optionally Bloom filters. A Bloom filter is only a prefilter: false positives require an exact final check, and false negatives are forbidden.
- Preserve INNER join multiplicity separately from SEMI membership semantics. Naively concatenating overlapping SEMI batches must not duplicate event rows.
- Extend to keys produced by remote inputs only with explicit execution ordering, memory and snapshot analysis. This does not introduce a cluster-wide snapshot.

## Acceptance

- PostgreSQL 18/19 tests must cover the example, an INNER variant with duplicate keys, NULLs, empty results, parameter changes, batching boundaries and rescans.
- Compare results with ordinary execution and assert remote predicates, skipped shards and reduced transferred rows.
- Demonstrate bounded memory/spill behavior and correct fallback when a runtime filter is not selective or exceeds its limits.
- Keep the existing single-table lookup optimization working and cost-competitive.

items.title: paige_social_posts: operator-vs-tenant schema conflict leaves two Solo Social surfaces non-functional on prod (§9 product decision)
items.body:
Surfaced by the §5 compliance pass on PR #1159 (the #1155 fresh-replay repair). Filed as an out-of-scope finding per the standing directive ("park unrelated findings with exact evidence") — it is **not** fixed by #1159, which deliberately only unbreaks fresh replay without making the operator-vs-tenant decision.

## The conflict
`public.paige_social_posts` is defined twice, with two incompatible schemas under one name:

- **Operator schema (LIVE on prod)** — `20260627193825_*.sql`: `platform`/`caption`/`posted_at`/`status(enum)`, **no `tenant_id`**; RLS `is_platform_owner()` (operator-only, set in `20260721053737:82`). The live writer `supabase/functions/meta-schedule-post/index.ts:75` inserts exactly this schema (platform-wide, single `META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN`), and `20261210000000:30-36` explicitly warns that a tenant-scoped read of this table would "publish every workspace's post to one shared page — a §9 breach."
- **Tenant schema (intended, never applied to prod)** — `20270117000000_social_operations.sql`: `tenant_id NOT NULL`/`content`/`targets`/`job_attempt_id`/`published_at`, tenant RLS. Its `create table if not exists` no-ops against the pre-existing operator table, so this schema never materialized. (The migration has never applied to prod — `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` has no `paige_social_accounts` type. #1159 unblocks the migration's *other* objects but intentionally keeps `paige_social_posts` on the operator schema.)

## Impact — two wired-but-non-functional Solo surfaces on prod
- `src/solo/social-studio.tsx:466` — reads/writes the **tenant** schema (`.content`/`.targets`/`.content_type`, writes `{content}`). On the live operator table these columns don't exist and tenant RLS returns 0 rows → **non-functional on prod** (a §70 "wired but a human can't complete it" surface).
- `src/solo/settings-integrations-social.tsx:57` — reads `paige_social_accounts`, which does not exist on prod yet (created net-new when #1159's migration finally applies, then empty under tenant RLS).

Both are reachable (via `growth2.tsx` / `settings-integrations.tsx`) but cannot complete their flow today. This is pre-existing, not caused by #1159.

## The decision to make
Reconcile to ONE schema for `paige_social_posts`:
- **Operator-only** (drop the tenant pipeline ambition; fix/retire the two Solo surfaces), or
- **Tenant-scoped** (requires per-tenant OAuth — provider app review + per-tenant tokens — because the current platform-wide `META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN` path cannot be tenant-scoped without the §9 breach above; and `meta-schedule-post` would need to move off the operator insert). Making the live table `tenant_id NOT NULL` without this **breaks `meta-schedule-post`**.

## Also noted (pre-existing, same file)
`20270117000000`'s header advertises five `social.*` Spine capabilities (`social.accounts_read/.post_draft/.post_schedule/.post_publish/.analytics_read`) but only `social.post_publish` is ever registered (the others are never inserted into `registry.ts`/`paige_action_kinds`). Reconcile the header when the pipeline is actually built.

## Related
- #1155 (fresh-replay repair — the guard that made this visible; PR #1159)
- #1154 (`social_post` edge fn non-functional — `paige-social/index.ts` references undefined `content`)
- Harness Completion Map §5.7 (`docs/delivery/harness-completion-map.md`) records this as the Social domain's next-phase product decision.

items.title: [Phase 1a] book-service: консьюмер сигналов в схему signals (append-only)
items.body:
# [Phase 1a] book-service: консьюмер сигналов в схему `signals` (append-only)

**Метка:** `phase1a`
**Приоритет:** P0
**Размер:** M
**Зависимости:** #89 (продюсер book-service), #90 (`book.wishlisted`), #91 (`book.rated`)

## Контекст

Продукт: без сырых сигналов нет ни витрины «популярное», ни оценки воронки `browse → interest → loan` (`docs/product/08-metrics.md`), ни данных для персонализации Phase 2. Решение Q2: консьюмер живёт в **book-service**, пишет в схему `signals` внутри `book-db`; новый микросервис запрещён (`docs/product/03-architecture-deltas.md`).

## Что сделать

- **Файлы (создать):**
  - `services/book-service/migrations/005_signals.sql` — схема `signals` + таблица `signal_events` (DDL ниже) + `reading_progress` (см. ниже: таблица создаётся сразу, но читается только в Phase 2).
  - `services/book-service/internal/signals/domain.go` — сущность `SignalEvent`, whitelist типов, нормализация payload.
  - `services/book-service/internal/signals/repository.go` — контракт `SignalStore`.
  - `services/book-service/internal/signals/postgres/store.go` — реализация (`INSERT` в `signals.signal_events`, `ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING`).
  - `services/book-service/internal/consumer/signals/consumer.go` — `Run(ctx, subscriber events.Subscriber, store SignalStore, log *slog.Logger) error` по образцу `services/ai-service/internal/consumer/consumer.go`: durable очередь `book-service.signals`, bindings `book.#`, `loan.#`, `ai.#`, `reading.#`, ручной ack.
  - `services/book-service/internal/signals/domain_test.go`, `.../consumer/signals/consumer_test.go`.
- **Файлы (изменить):**
  - `services/book-service/cmd/server/main.go` — открывать AMQP-транспорт (`openBroker` из #89), поднимать консьюмер в горутине с тем же `ctx`, что и серверы. Если брокер не настроен — консьюмер не поднимать (лог `warn`).
  - `services/book-service/internal/config/config.go` — при необходимости поля брокера через `pkg/config` (см. `services/ai-service/internal/config/config.go`).
  - `services/book-service/README.md` — раздел «События: консьюмер сигналов», таблица типов.
  - `KODA.md` — структура book-service (`internal/consumer/signals`, `internal/signals`), статус событийной шины.
- **Логика:**
  - Тип события берётся из конверта (`events.Event.EventType`), whitelist: `book.viewed`, `book.wishlisted`, `book.rated`, `book.created`, `book.updated`, `book.deleted`, `loan.issued`, `loan.returned`, `loan.overdue`, `reading.progress`, `ai.recommend.shown`, `ai.recommend.clicked`, `ai.chat.asked`.
  - Payload распарсивается в map/структуру и сериализуется в `jsonb`. Поля `reader_id`, `book_id`, `copy_id`, `loan_id`, `tenant_id` извлекаются в отдельные колонки, если присутствуют.
  - События вне whitelist — ack без записи (не nack, иначе DLQ забьётся).
  - `event_id` из конверта → `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`: повторная доставка не создаёт дубль.
  - `reading.progress` дополнительно делает upsert в `signals.reading_progress` (см. «Технические заметки»).
- **API:** нет (внутренний консьюмер).
- **Миграции:** `services/book-service/migrations/005_signals.sql`:
  ```sql
  CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS signals;

  CREATE TABLE signals.signal_events (
      id           UUID        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      event_id    UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      event_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id   UUID NOT NULL,
      reader_id    UUID,
      book_id     UUID,
      copy_id     UUID,
      loan_id     UUID,
      metadata     JSONB       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      copy_id      UUID,
      loan_id      UUID,
      occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
  );
  CREATE INDEX signal_events_tenant_type_time_idx
      ON signals.signal_events (tenant_id, event_type, occurred_at DESC);
  CREATE INDEX signal_events_user_time_idx
      ON signals.signal_events (tenant_id, reader_id, occurred_at DESC) WHERE reader_id IS NOT NULL;

  CREATE TABLE signals.reading_progress (
      id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL,
      reader_id      UUID NOT NULL,
      book_id        UUID NOT NULL,
      percent        SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
      updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
      CONSTRAINT reading_progress_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, reader_id, book_id)
  );
  ```
- **Frontend:** нет.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cd services/book-service && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` — зелено.
- [ ] Unit-тесты: конверт `book.viewed` → строка с `event_type='book.viewed'`, `book_id`, `reader_id`, `occurred_at` из конверта; неизвестный тип → нет записи, `handler` вернул `nil`; битый JSON payload → `handler` вернул ошибку (nack без requeue).
- [ ] Повторная обработка того же `event_id` не увеличивает число строк (тест на мок-хранилище + SQL-тест с `ON CONFLICT`).
- [ ] При старте с настроенным брокером очередь `book-service.signals` durable и забинжена на `library.events` с key `book.#`, `loan.#`, `ai.#`, `reading.#` (проверяется интеграционным тестом с `RABBITMQ_TEST_URL`, иначе skip — как `pkg/events/amqp/transport_test.go`).
- [ ] Ручная проверка: `docker compose up -d --build`, `curl -X POST localhost:8091/v1/books ...`, затем `curl localhost:8092/v1/.../login` не требуется — достаточно `docker exec library-book-db psql -U library -d library_books -c "select event_type, count(*) from signals.signal_events group by 1"` → видны `book.created` и последующие `book.viewed`.
- [ ] `reading.progress` c `percent=120` не падает в 500: запись отклонена на уровне домена, событие ack-нуто, в лог — warn.
- [ ] `services/book-service/README.md` содержит перечень потребляемых routing key и схему `signals`; `KODA.md` актуальна.

## Технические заметки

- Миграция нумеруется `005`, чтобы не конфликтовать с `002_wishlist.sql` (#90) и `003_ratings.sql` (#91); если те issues сменили номера — синхронизировать имя файла до merge.
- Консьюмер не должен хранить состояние в памяти и не должен блокировать `Run` на long-running запросах: один `INSERT` на сообщение, `prefetch` из `events.QueueConfig.PrefetchCount`.
- Схема `signals` живёт в той же базе `library_books`, но в отдельном schema — права на `signals` не давать роли приложения для `SELECT` из `books` (приватность: `docs/product/06-signals-and-analytics.md`).
- Долгие запросы к `signals` из UI в Phase 1 запрещены — витрина «популярное» считается job'ом в Phase 2.
- Не дублировать реализацию ack/reconnect: только `pkg/events` + `pkg/events/amqp`.

## Ссылки на docs/product

`03-architecture-deltas.md` (диаграмма «Signals pipeline»), `04-data-model.md` (схема `signals`, `signal_events`, `reading_progress`), `06-signals-and-analytics.md` (whitelist типов, приватность, retention), `02-roadmap.md` (exit criteria Phase 1).

## Ссылки на код

`pkg/events/events.go` (`QueueConfig`, `Subscriber`, `Handler`), `pkg/events/envelope.go`, `pkg/events/amqp/transport.go`, `services/ai-service/internal/consumer/consumer.go`, `services/notification-service/internal/consumer/`, `services/user-service/internal/consumer/consumer.go`, `services/book-service/cmd/server/main.go`.

items.title: SSO 1/4: oidc_idp_config schema, repository, and encryption
items.body:
## What

First slice of #265, split per ADR-0044 (docs/adr/0044-sso-oidc-account-linking-and-tenant-boundary.md). Additive-only: a new table, a new repository, no auth-behavior change, safe to merge and deploy alone.

- New migration: `oidc_idp_config` (`id`, `tenant_id` UNIQUE, `issuer_url`, `client_id`, `encrypted_client_secret`, `allowed_domains TEXT[]`, `enforce_sso BOOLEAN`, timestamps) - `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, idempotent per repo convention.
- New `OidcIdpConfigRepository` (`packages/backend/src/db/repositories/`) - `findByTenantId`, `upsert`. Secret encrypted before write / decrypted after read via `getEncryptionService()` / `CredentialEncryption` (`packages/backend/src/utils/encryption.ts`), matching the Jira/Linear integration-credential pattern (ADR-0044 Decision 6) - **never a plaintext column**.
- Export the new repository from `packages/backend/src/db/repositories.ts`.

## Why

ADR-0044 resolved the design; this is pure plumbing underneath it. Kept as its own PR specifically so the highest-stakes pieces (login flow, existing-endpoint guards) get reviewed without a schema/repo diff mixed in - the opposite of PR #345, which bundled all of this into one 16-file diff that took three review rounds to converge.

## How

Follow ADR-0044 Decision 6 exactly for the encryption pattern (cite `jira/config.ts` as the reference implementation). No API routes in this slice - repository only, exercised by its own unit tests (round-trip encrypt/decrypt, upsert idempotency via `UNIQUE(tenant_id)`).

Rollback: drop the migration, delete the repository file. Nothing else references either yet.

Refs #265. Depends on: none - this is the base slice.

**Phase 2 — Pipeline** · Parent: #1 · Est. 1 day · Plan §4, §6

`src/leadquali/adapters/store_postgres.py`, implementing the `LeadStore` and `TenantConfigSource` ports from #14.

### Scope

- [ ] Repository methods for leads, assessments, routing events and feedback. **Every method takes `tenant_id` and every query filters on it** — no exceptions, including the "obviously single-tenant" ones.
- [ ] `upsert_lead()` handling the `(tenant_id, submission_id)` conflict without raising, returning whether it was a new lead — this is how the worker detects an SQS redelivery.
- [ ] Persist the full assessment including `model_id`, `prompt_version`, `effort`, token counts, `cost_usd` and `latency_ms`.
- [ ] Tenant config loader reading `tenants.icp_config` jsonb into the `TenantConfig` model from #8, replacing the Phase 1 file loader behind the same port.
- [ ] Connection handling written for Lambda from the start: engine created at module scope, `pool_pre_ping`, short pool, no long-lived transactions. RDS Proxy sits in front in #27.
- [ ] Integration tests against the Docker Postgres from #15 (marked so CI can run them with a service container).

### Acceptance criteria

- A test asserts a repository call with tenant A's id cannot read tenant B's rows — this test is the seed of the isolation suite in #32.
- Replaying the same lead is a no-op that returns the existing record rather than a duplicate.
- Integration tests pass in CI against a Postgres service container.
- No SQL string interpolation of user input anywhere.

**Depends on:** #14, #15.

items.title: [FEATURE] Speciality tenant-side override support
items.body:
## Task Brief

**Type:** feature | **Tier:** T4 | **Scope:** fullstack | **Risk:** N
**Route:** Architect Path (new structure needed — new merge/resolve logic, new plan-gating middleware, new tenant routes, new frontend surface)
**Session:** `.ai/sessions/2026-07-27-speciality-tenant-override.md`
**Depends on:** #3 (Speciality super-admin master list + plan gating scaffolding — must not be broken by this ticket)

## User Requirement
Add tenant-side override support for the Speciality feature (already built for super-admin in Issue #3). Tenant admins should be able to view the master speciality list, create tenant-scoped overrides (full-row override keyed by slug, mirroring `themeController.js`'s tenant_id=null + tenant_id=<tenant> merge pattern), add their own specialities, and revert overrides back to the inherited master version. Gated behind the existing `specialities` plan feature flag via `hasFeature()`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tenant admin without `specialities` plan feature sees locked/upsell UI and gets 403 on write attempts (with upgrade-pointing message)
- [ ] Tenant admin with the feature can override a master speciality's content+SEO fields (creates `tenant_id=<tenant>` row keyed by slug)
- [ ] Tenant admin can add a new speciality scoped to their own tenant
- [ ] Tenant admin can revert an override back to inherited master version (mirrors `resetTheme` pattern)
- [ ] `resolveSpecialities(tenantId)` / `resolveSpecialityBySlug(tenantId, slug)` correctly merge master + tenant-override rows by slug (full-row override, not deep-field merge)
- [ ] Super-admin's existing master-list CRUD (Issue #3) continues working unchanged — verified via regression pass
- [ ] Composite unique constraint on `(tenant_id, slug)` respected by new tenant create/update logic
- [ ] Public endpoint tenant-awareness implemented if a tenant-detection precedent exists in the codebase, else explicitly documented as a known gap (no half-implemented logic)
- [ ] No breaking changes to existing `speciality.service.ts` exports used by the super-admin page

## Constraints
- Must NOT modify `backend/models/Speciality.js`, existing super-admin controller/route exports, or `super-admin/specialities/page.tsx` in a way that breaks super-admin CRUD — additive only
- Feature-gating 403 enforcement is REQUIRED in this ticket (unlike #3's scaffolding-only flag)
- Full-row override merge (ThemeSetting style), not deep field merge
- Commit messages use `[LABEL] description` format per CLAUDE.md
- **PIPELINE OVERRIDE:** pr-reviewer-agent must STOP before git push / PR creation and report "ready to push, awaiting human confirmation" with a branch/commit summary. No push or PR without explicit human confirmation. Applies to this and all related Speciality tickets.
